model.loading: local_files_only=True; safetensors; reuse pinned pretrained encoder; replace mismatched 3-way NLI classifier head with a seeded 2-way head

stage1.lr_schedule: linear warmup then linear decay to zero by final optimizer step
stage1.class_weight_formula: weight_c = N_train / (2 * N_class_c), using only fold training labels
stage1.checkpoint_selection: final model after exactly one synthetic epoch

stage2.lr_schedule: linear warmup then linear decay to zero by final optimizer step
stage2.class_weight_formula: weight_c = N_train / (2 * N_class_c), using only fold training labels
stage2.checkpoint_selection: final model after exactly five epochs; no held-out-based selection

output.oof_rule: Five independent final checkpoints, one per locked fold; predict held-out fold only; concatenate to 561 unique IDs after all five runs.

training_protocol.architecture: five fold-specific synthetic Stage-1 then human Stage-2 fits, both with frozen E11-D contrastive loss
training_protocol.stage1_choice: One fixed conservative epoch; all other optimizer/input settings inherited from E11-A. No search.
training_protocol.selection_override: Current user instruction uses the full definitive pool after leakage/duplicate exclusions; supersedes earlier teacher-preparation balanced/capped selection. Teacher artifacts unchanged.
training_protocol.leakage_policy: NFC whitespace-normalized casefold full/task-source/task-target/task-reference/source-pair and global hypothesis matches to outer validation; no validation labels used.

contrastive.representation: Final encoder layer; mean pool each paired sequence using fast-tokenizer sequence_ids; exclude special and padding tokens; include frozen textual prefixes.
contrastive.contextualization: Both representations are contextualized jointly by the original cross-encoder pair; no independent encoder passes.
contrastive.negative: label 1 hallucination: penalize cosine above zero
contrastive.rationale: Simple standard pairwise cosine embedding objective with modest fixed auxiliary weight; no projection head, mined pairs, alternatives or parameter selection.

synthetic_pool_provenance.leakage_limit: Conservative exact normalized content/source matching; undocumented upstream semantic derivations cannot be proven absent. No cross-split upstream source IDs are supplied.

runtime.definition: Per-stage time from training loop through checkpoint saving and hashing; excludes model setup and heldout inference. Concurrent sums are not wall time or billing duration.

oof_checks: 561 unique complete IDs; exact tasks, labels and folds; finite [0,1] probabilities; no fold collapsed
